rules: Character IDs never change between episodes.
Face, body proportions, hair, beard and core identity never regenerate from scratch when a master image exists.
Step 5 must contain the same canonical character references used by Step 6.
Each episode has exactly one physical location master; camera angle may change but geography does not reset.
Scene N continuityEndFrame must equal Scene N+1 continuityStartState.
From Scene 2 onward use previous scene image together with Character Master and Location Master.
No unexplained costume, prop, lighting or position reset.
